historical_record.description: The Works Progress Administration added a one-storey concrete extension to Kezar Pavilion.

The Board of Park Commissioners approved its president's having let J. A. Bryant, the low bidder at $114,280, start building the basketball pavilion at Kezar Stadium before the full board voted, because of the haste needed; Architects and Engineers Associated were its architects.
